types.description: Three-pole rotary motor circuit breaker; thermal adjustment 2.5-4 A; bare GV2-P08

document.title: GV2P08 — TeSys GV2 motor circuit breaker, product data sheet

modelingNotes: Exact 2017 sheet and catalog match 2.5-4 A rotary thermal-magnetic breaker; no successor substitution.

Three mechanically linked poles with thermal and magnetic protection. Diagram reference state is OFF/open, not an inferred installed position. Contact functions represent complete protected switched paths; trip curves are not simulated.
AC 50/60 Hz; thermal adjustment 2.5-4 A, Ith 4 A, magnetic release 51 A. No installation setting assigned. Ue and Ui capability 690 V AC is documentation, not nominal circuit intent.
IEC 60947-2 Icu: 100 kA at 230/240, 400/415, 440 and 500 V AC; 8 kA at 690 V AC. Conditional ratings are not flattened into scalar interrupt limits.

Connections and Schema p.11 of Schneider GV2P08 sheet dated 2024-07-01, manufacturer-authored AECOM mirror, visually reviewed: https://aecom.vn/document/GV2P08_Datasheet.pdf. Main terminal markings preserved exactly.

Bare breaker only. Separately ordered auxiliary contacts, release blocks and line barriers are excluded. No permanent fixed links and no universally required terminals; application wiring is not prescribed.

Screw-clamp torque 1.7 N.m. The 2017 sheet lists two conductors per terminal with conditional sizes: solid 1-6 mm², flexible without ends 1.5-6 mm², flexible with ends 1-4 mm². Shared connection policy does not enforce clamp capacity.

connectionCoverage.notes: Six main screw-clamp terminals of the bare GV2P08, verified from its exact-product schematic. No separate PE, neutral, supply, signal, communication or auxiliary terminals in this base-device inventory. Separately ordered accessories are excluded.
